name: Alibaba Cloud
tagline: Enterprise cloud servers (ECS) with strong Asia-Pacific latency and a 3-month trial
description: Alibaba Cloud's Elastic Compute Service (ECS) offers pay-as-you-go and subscription cloud servers with a free 3-month trial and low-latency Asia-Pacific infrastructure.
about: This entry covers Alibaba Cloud narrowly as a website-hosting option through its Elastic Compute Service (ECS) — not its full enterprise cloud catalog (AI, big data, logistics, etc.), which is out of scope here. ECS is Alibaba Cloud's virtual-server product: you provision a VM, install your own stack (or a marketplace image), and manage it yourself, similar to an AWS EC2 or DigitalOcean droplet rather than a managed cPanel host.

Alibaba Cloud runs promotional entry-level ECS/VPS offers starting around $9.9/year for new accounts, alongside standard pay-as-you-go and subscription billing that scales with vCPU, memory, bandwidth and region. New users also get a 3-month free trial with credits redeemable across 40+ products, cumulatively worth up to $450-$1,300 over a 12-month period — useful for testing an ECS instance before committing to paid billing. Exact per-instance pricing varies by region and instance family, so confirm current rates on Alibaba Cloud's own pricing calculator before purchasing.

The platform's clearest strength for hosting purposes is infrastructure reach across Asia-Pacific: Alibaba Cloud operates 29 global regions and 106 availability zones and has held the #1 IaaS market-share position in the Asia-Pacific region per Gartner. That makes it a genuinely strong pick if your audience is concentrated in China, Southeast Asia or nearby markets, but a less obvious choice for a site with no APAC-specific latency need, where a simpler managed host may be easier to run.
policies: Refund and termination terms differ by billing model — pay-as-you-go usage is billed for actual consumption, while subscription (annual/monthly) instances follow Alibaba Cloud's own refund schedule for unused, unexpired terms. Check the exact terms on Alibaba Cloud's billing and refund policy pages before purchasing, since terms can vary by product and region.

The free 3-month trial's credit allocation and eligible products are set by Alibaba Cloud and can change; new sign-ups should verify current trial terms directly on the site before assuming a specific credit amount applies to their account.
